entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: ...Oh, you have the elegance and[n]refinement so sorely lacking in the[n]ordinary citizenry!

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: My, such flattery! A high-class aura[n]emanates from you as well!

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: So you noticed! Hahahaha!

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Most certainly! Ahahaha!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, these guys totally ignore me when[n]I try and talk to 'em...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do I look that much like I don't got any[n]money? Is it 'cause of the skull mask or[n]something?

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Hm...? One of the VIPs used to belong[n]to nobility?

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Yes, that must be why he can enter the[n]sacred place. I heard he's not easily[n]seen either...

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: But why would someone of his stature[n]always be by the poolside?

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Well, he must like it there for some[n]reason... but I don't think it's the[n]swimming. Hahahaha!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Beyond this door is the "VIP area," and[n]the main assembly hall is a "sacred place."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It looks like we can't get in unless Shido[n]accepts us.

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Hm... So that is the president of a[n]TV station?

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Indeed. Mr. Shido has quite the large[n]circle of acquaintances.

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: It seems you have to be at least that[n]important to be considered a VIP...

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: I'm truly envious...

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Why don't you go play the slots with him?[n]That might get his attention...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears these people all want to[n]be accepted as one of Shido's special[n]customers.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way, I've gained some information[n]on the VIPs. We should discuss later.

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: My... Even Mr. Ooe is a VIP?

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: I just saw him at the restaurant... To think[n]an important politician like him has been[n]invited here...

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Well, support from the political world[n]should mean mental shutdowns are as[n]viable as ever!

entries.speaker: Female Guest
entries.en: Ahaha, I'm quite envious... I wonder[n]if there's a way I can get to know him[n]better myself...

entries.speaker: Male Guest
entries.en: Hahaha, if you wish...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hearing people speak so casually about[n]the mental shutdown business makes[n]my head spin...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...But it seems as though we need[n]certification from five VIPs to become[n]a "special customer."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: These people are willing to share[n]anything. Perhaps it's because their[n]faces are hidden?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, I'm not entirely sure how to speak[n]to people here...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I either remained silent or spoke in[n]simple pleasantries during Father's[n]business relations...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You're some kinda sadist for making me[n]get info from complete strangers, Joker!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But I'll do it! I'm going to avenge my mom.
